build_mobilenet_model: build a MobileNet model with a configurable number of output classes for CIFAR classification
create_block_module: create a Block module with depthwise and pointwise convolutions for MobileNet architecture
run_mobilenet_forward: run a forward pass through the MobileNet model on an input tensor
review_mobilenet_cfg: review the MobileNet configuration list that defines channel depths and stride values
test_block_forward: test the Block forward method with depthwise separable convolution on input features
